steps: sh qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out> c_none_small decent 1 --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --ship=small (repeat per strategy and seed, 480 jobs in logs/qa-t182/batch/jobs.txt)
read the RESULT line: win_cycle, ending_id, outcome
expected: A run that holds the Bazaar win line records a win at the win cycle; otherwise a loss, or END_UNFINISHED at the last cycle.
actual: 0 of 480 runs record a win (win_cycle -1 everywhere). Every non-bankrupt run ends END_UNFINISHED at cycle 40. The bot's Bazaar-win detection is a stub (T281), so it is not known whether the game or the bot is at fault. Win timing (cycle 22 to 30) cannot be judged.

expected: No strategy is best across seeds in a CEO and ship combo, or the gap is explained by the design.
actual: always_expand has the top final cash in 5 of 6 seeds (mean 19365 vs decent 9733). Decent is weak here: seed 4 ends at 503, seed 5 at 165. Across all 120 combo and seed cells, decent is top in 65, never_expand in 30, always_expand in 19, sloppy in 6, so this is one combo, not a global dominant strategy.

expected: A decent player that expands ends with healthy cash in most seeds.
actual: 15 of 120 decent runs end below 1000 cash at cycle 40 (lowest 30 at c_ceo_woman_01_small seed 3). The same seed reaches 18000 or more under other combos (for example c_none_dart seed 2 ends at 18497). Wide spread, not a crash.

steps: grep warning_streak in the RESULT issues
expected: Routes run, or a 'Waiting for room' warning clears within a cycle or two.
actual: 'route 12 shows Waiting for room for 3+ cycles in a row' fires in 26 runs (40 warnings): decent 23, always_expand 17. Examples: c_none_small decent 2 and 4, c_ceo_woman_02_dart decent 1 to 3. Cause not found (no run error).

expected: UNKNOWN: whether END_BANKRUPT at cycle 6 is intended for always_expand with the fleet ship.
actual: END_BANKRUPT (loss) at cycle 6 with 14 cash in 5 always_expand runs: c_ceo_man_01_fleet seeds 1 and 6, c_ceo_man_02_fleet seed 5, c_ceo_woman_02_fleet seed 3, c_none_fleet seed 5. 14 of 120 always_expand runs end bankrupt, cycles 6 to 32.

expected: UNKNOWN: whether exploration mode should switch itself off while a dead world waits for MIN_3.
actual: With no dead world buildable (before cycle 15 or before MIN_3), exploration stays on with the ship idle after 50 cycles, leaving one planet unestablished. Once cycle 16 and the MIN chain are reached it completes in about 2 cycles. No permanent soft-lock; design question only.
